title: fix(plugin-kanban): delete KanbanEnhanced.tsx, the module no export or barrel reached (objectui#8932)
body:
Fixes #8932

Clause-②: no

`@object-ui/plugin-kanban`'s `exports` map has no `./KanbanEnhanced` entry. The published 17.6.0 map is `.` only; this release's in-repo map is `.` and `./style.css`. The entry point does not export the component by name, so the declared surface does not move (the ruling's ③). The changeset still names the file for anyone who deep-imported it.

Executes ruling `5634037484`, ratified `5810258711` (maintainer: 「同意」): **A — delete `packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanEnhanced.tsx`** and its test references. PM claim `5830002817`. Rework round after contract review `5831016914`. Implemented by the `os-dev` run in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`.

## What changes

- `packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanEnhanced.tsx` is deleted.
- **Where the component was.** I read the published 17.6.0 tarball with `npm pack`:
  - `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.umd.cjs` carry the component inlined (a `KanbanEnhanced` export of the chunk, bound to the minified function `ct`). It was reachable through the `kanban-enhanced` registry key and the entry's `kanbanComponents` map.
  - `dist/index.d.ts` references `./KanbanEnhanced`.
  - The `exports` map is `.` only. The tarball contains no CSS file.
  - The component leaves the bundle in this release with the objectui#8257 / objectui#8802 key retirement (the pending `8802-8257-8008` entry), not with this PR. Building the base (`d22b37bd8`, after #8865) and this branch, `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.umd.cjs` contain `KanbanEnhanced` 0 times on both sides (control: `KanbanImpl` is found in `dist/index.js`).
- **What this PR removes from the published package**, measured by building `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` on the base and on the branch:
  - `dist/KanbanEnhanced.d.ts` and `dist/KanbanEnhanced.d.ts.map`. Nothing else leaves the `dist/` listing.
  - `dist/index.d.ts` is byte-identical (`cmp` exit 0).
  - `@tanstack/react-virtual` leaves the plugin's `dependencies`. The deleted module was the only file in the package that imported it, and `check-unused-dependencies` fails without this change. `pnpm-lock.yaml` loses just this importer's three lines. `@object-ui/plugin-grid` still declares the package, so no resolution moves.
- **`style.css`.** The stylesheet first ships in this release (pending `4929-plugin-published-stylesheets.md`). Built after this deletion, it does not carry three utility rules that only the deleted module used: `border-border/50`, `text-yellow-500` and `shadow-xl`. Building with the module keeps 65 rules; building without it keeps 62.
- **`@object-ui/types` JSDoc** (comment only). Four present-tense passages that named `KanbanEnhanced` as a live reader now name `KanbanImpl` as the one board. The two past counts are dated and name objectui#8932 rather than being deleted:
  - `KanbanCard`: "what `KanbanImpl` reads back".
  - `KanbanColumn.cards`: "measured at objectui#6939: 12 lines in `KanbanImpl`, and 8 in `KanbanEnhanced` until objectui#8932 deleted it".
  - `ObjectKanbanSchema.columns`, twice: "what `KanbanImpl` consumes", and "counted when there were two board implementations … `KanbanImpl` alone still reads all six members". I re-measured that last claim: `KanbanImpl.tsx` reads `id`, `title`, `cards`, `limit`, `className` and `collapsed` off the lane.
  - The past-tense passages on `KanbanColumn.collapsed`, on the retired `color` member, and on the retired lane-collapse key stay as they were.
  - `git diff -w` over the two files shows only lines starting with `*`.
- Changesets:
  - `.changeset/8932-retire-kanban-enhanced.md` (`'@object-ui/plugin-kanban': patch`) states how the component left the bundle, what this change removes, the deep-import and dependency notes, and that `style.css` ships without the three rules.
  - `.changeset/8932-kanban-enhanced-types-jsdoc.md` (`'@object-ui/types': patch`) is one sentence on the JSDoc.

## Premise re-checked on the current `main` (`d22b37bd8`)

**H1: confirmed for the source tree, with lit controls.**

- The in-repo `exports` keys are `.` and `./style.css`.
- The entry has no `import` or `export` line that names `KanbanEnhanced` (grep exit 1). Control: the same grep finds the `React.lazy` import of `./KanbanImpl`.
- A module-specifier grep over the whole tree (`from` / `import(` / `require(` / `vi.mock(`) finds `KanbanEnhanced` twice, both times in tests. Non-test importers: 0. Control: the same pattern for `KanbanImpl` finds the production import in `packages/plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx`.
- ⚠️ Corrected in this rework: the first round built only the base and the branch, both after #8865, and wrongly concluded the component was never bundled. The published 17.6.0 package does bundle it (see "Where the component was" above).
- PR #8865's registry-key retirement did not change the file's situation. `kanban-enhanced` is unregistered and pinned by `kanban-family-registry-keys-retired-8257.test.ts`. The file was still on disk at the base.

**H2: falsified.** The module had two test references, not one:

- `src/__tests__/kanban-handler-slots-7664.test.tsx`: a `vi.mock` target whose prop recorder no leg read.
- `src/cardPredicateScope.test.tsx`: a direct import. This is the reference the `index.tsx` tombstone itself named.

I handled both as the ruling's intent directs: each test is deleted, or rewritten to what it still pins.

## Test files: every assertion kept, removed or moved

`kanban-handler-slots-7664.test.tsx`: the `KanbanEnhanced` prop recorder and its `enhanced` log are removed. All legs are kept verbatim, because every probe records the `KanbanImpl` chunk. The `log` parameter type narrows to `keyof typeof recorded`. A docblock paragraph records the removal.

`cardPredicateScope.test.tsx`:

- **Removed:** "KanbanEnhanced binds the ambient predicate scope alongside the card". Its `KanbanBoard` twin stays and pins the same verdict on the one registered board.
- **Moved, subject `KanbanEnhanced` → `KanbanBoard`:**
  - "a scope-gated condition fails SOFT (no style) outside the provider". It is now the negative control for the live positive leg, which had none of its own.
  - "a bare-field condition no longer binds the card (objectui#5741)". Its canonical-spelling control moved with it.
- **Kept unchanged:** "KanbanBoard (impl) binds the ambient predicate scope alongside the card" and the four relation-field legs (objectui#3501).

## Other files the deletion forced

- `packages/plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx` (comment only). The `kanban-enhanced` tombstone said the file "stays". It now records the deletion, names the new pin, and says that through 17.6.0 the component was also bundled behind the `kanban-enhanced` key.
- `scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`: in `KNOWN_COLLISIONS`, `ConditionalFormattingRule` drops its third site, the deleted file. This baseline is shrink-only and fails on a stale site.
  - Ablation on the committed tree: I put the three-site entry back with `ablation-replace` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `0a8b7933d98f` → `d610bed3eea6`).
  - Result: "declares no name twice outside the named, shrinking baseline" goes red with "KNOWN_COLLISIONS lists collisions that no longer exist", naming the deleted path.
  - Restore: blob equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- `packages/plugin-kanban/package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml`: the dependency removal described above.

## Pending changesets (H4)

Three pending changesets are reconciled in the objectui#10533 / #10540 form: the sentence is scoped to "at this change" and a dated note is added. The frontmatter stays byte-identical: the md5 of each file's frontmatter block is equal on base and head, and `check-changeset-overwrite` prints the same "declared at base" and "declares now" lines.

- `8802-8257-8008-kanban-gantt-family-retirement.md`: "`KanbanEnhanced.tsx` has zero non-test importers. ⛔ The file is deliberately left in place".
- `6172-markdown-kanban-one-authority.md`: "both files now re-point at it".
- `8913-object-kanban-columns-declared.md`: "exactly the members the two board implementations read" and "before either board implementation sees one". `check-changeset-claims` surfaced this entry once the branch edited `objectql.ts`.

Read and left as they are:

- `6939-kanban-column-cards.md`: a measurement anchored at `78a3cc238`.
- `9628-kanban-column-collapsed-honoured.md`: describes the reader as it was before objectui#9628.
- `6172-kanban-trio-rename.md`: it names the `kanban-enhanced` registry key among "four registered kanban renderers". That went stale with the objectui#8257 / #8802 key retirement, not with this file deletion.
- `6349-types-internal-name-collisions-batch-1.md`: flagged for naming the ratchet file. Its "43 entries → 40" is that change's own count, and this PR does not change the entry count.
- The other pending entries flagged because they name `complex.ts` or `objectql.ts` describe members this PR does not touch. The edits in those files are comment-only on the four kanban passages above.

## `CardTemplate` / `ColumnWidthConfig`: report only, not deleted

Neither type is in `KanbanEnhanced`'s condition. Both are exported through `.` (the entry's `export type` line from `./types`), and the deleted module named neither of them (0 hits).

- **`CardTemplate` is consumed.** `CardTemplates.tsx` imports it for its `templates` prop and its `onSelect` signature, and `CardTemplates` is itself exported from the entry. Importers of the `CardTemplates` component in `apps/`, `packages/`, `examples/`, `content/` and `skills/`, other than its own file and the entry: 0.
- **`ColumnWidthConfig` has no reader.** 5 non-test source files name it: its declaration in `packages/types/src/complex.ts`, its Zod mirror, and three re-exports. That matches the reading objectui#8522 recorded.
- Control on the same query: `KanbanCard` is named by the consumers `KanbanImpl.tsx` and `useQuickAddReorder.ts`.

## Pin (H5): red on the base, green on the head

`packages/plugin-kanban/src/__tests__/kanbanEnhancedRetired-8932.test.ts` follows the `chart-primitives-removed-7397` file-removal shape (`existsSync` with a lit control) and this package's `useColumnWidthsRetired-8522` naming. It pins two things:

- The file is absent from `src/`. Control: `KanbanImpl.tsx` in the same directory reads present.
- No file under `src/` names the module as a specifier (static or dynamic import, re-export, `require`, `vi.mock` / `vi.doMock`). Firing control: the same walk and pattern find the live board's lazy import in `index.tsx`.

Red on `76265dfdc` (the base plus the pin alone): 2 failed. The first reported `{ retired: true, live: true }`. The second listed `__tests__/kanban-handler-slots-7664.test.tsx` and `cardPredicateScope.test.tsx`, after its control assertion passed. Green on the head.

## Verification (final head `313ca6321`)

Test runs, all from the repo root under the shared verify lock:

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/types/ packages/plugin-kanban/`: 298 files and 5636 tests passed.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 scripts/` (the root-level suite, which is outside the package graph): 177 files passed, 2 skipped, 5303 tests passed.
  - At `2165ee472` (the deletion without the dependency removal) the same suite had 1 failure: `check-unused-dependencies.test.ts` › "is green: every gated declaration has a consumer", with `@tanstack/react-virtual` / `declared-without-consumer`.

Type-check, lint and build:

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.examples.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0 (at `abda7fc09`; the types source is unchanged since).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-kanban type-check`: exit 0. `--listFiles` on the test program lists the pin and both rewritten tests.
- `pnpm type-check:scripts`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-kanban lint`: 0 errors.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-kanban build`: exit 0.
- These four ran in the first round. The plugin-kanban source changed since only in one `index.tsx` comment.

Gates, all exit 0 at `313ca6321`:

- Changesets: `check-changeset-presence` ("7 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 2 changeset(s)"), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`.
- Report-only changeset gates: `check-changeset-claims` and `check-changeset-overwrite`. Their findings are addressed above.
- Line citations and bytes: `check:new-line-citations` ("0 new citation(s)") and `check:control-bytes`.

First-round gates, green at `a843148be` and not reached by the later edits:

- Mocks and test paths: `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, `check-vi-mock-inherit`, `check-vi-mock-override-shape`, `check-test-path-roots`.
- Source and dependency checks: `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:unused-deps`, `check:phantom-deps`.
- Lockfile: `check:lockfile-integrity` and `check:lockfile-dedupe`.
- Governed surface: `check-governed-queue-guard --test` answers NOT GOVERNED.

Merge check: `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main HEAD` against `origin/main` `50e41f738` exits 0. `main` has not touched any file this branch changes since `d22b37bd8`, so no merge was needed.

NOT MEASURED:

- `check:sdui-registration-pins`: it exits 2 without a console build (a prerequisite, not a verdict), and this diff changes no registration.
- `check:readme-exports`: it needs every package built. The entry's `dist/index.d.ts` is byte-identical.

## Surface

The claim's file surface named the module, one test, a pin, any pending changesets, and one new changeset. Beyond that, this PR touches:

- `cardPredicateScope.test.tsx`: it imported the module.
- `index.tsx` (comment only).
- `scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`: the ratchet.
- `packages/plugin-kanban/package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml`: the unused-dependency gate.
- The two `@object-ui/types` files, `packages/types/src/complex.ts` and `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` (JSDoc only), plus their changeset. This was asked for by the contract review.

Serial overlaps:

- objectui#10524 edits `ChatbotSchema.body` JSDoc in `complex.ts`, and objectui#10518 edits `ObjectChartSchema` in `objectql.ts`. Both are far from the four passages edited here.
- ⚠️ Draft PR #8941 (the lucide-react bump) edits the adjacent `lucide-react` line in `packages/plugin-kanban/package.json` and the same importer block in `pnpm-lock.yaml`. Whichever PR lands second meets a textual conflict there, cleared by merging `main` and re-running `pnpm install`.

## Acceptance notes

- Test docblocks still mention `KanbanEnhanced` as it was when they were written: `columnCollapsedHonoured-9628.test.tsx`, `examples/schema-catalog/test/kanban-column-cards-6939.test.tsx`, `object-kanban-columns-declared-8913.test.ts` and `one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`. They are not shipped and are left alone.
- Observation, not filed: the pending `8802-8257-8008` entry does not say that the entry's published `kanbanComponents` map narrows from four keys to `object-kanban` alone. In 17.6.0's typings the map included `'kanban-enhanced'`. That narrowing is objectui#8257 / #8802's, not this PR's.
